blocks.note: Choose saber for acquired knowledge or skill and poder for permission, opportunity, or circumstantial ability.
Form polite requests with conditional poder and past reproaches with imperfect or preterite poder plus a perfect infinitive.
Express present and past possibilities with puede que plus the subjunctive tense required by the time relationship.
Separate obligation expressed by deber or tener que from probability expressed by deber de and related modal readings.
Choose personal tener que or impersonal haber que from whether the obligation belongs to an identified participant.
Interpret querer across imperfect, preterite, negative-preterite, and polite-request contexts while tracking whether an outcome is asserted.
Translate present and past habitual meanings with soler plus an infinitive rather than copying an English modal tense.
